prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE tiny Victoria 3 naval designer COG HULL equipment UI icon.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for native painted embossed monochrome bronze/silver/gold metal glyphs, thin dark beveled edge, broad restrained highlights and tiny-size readability.
Primary request: a compact schematic WOODEN hull construction fragment for a cargo/troop transport cog, not an entire ship, not photorealistic, not a detailed engineering plan. Three-quarter isometric view slightly from above. Few large structural pieces and strong distinct silhouette legible at 32px, complete centered drawing with generous margins. Different construction technique, not just the same hull with more planks.
Color/material: ALL timber and fasteners in ONE metallic tier palette; symbolic UI coloration not a literal metal hull. No natural brown wood mixed with silver/gold. Genuine transparent blank background and gaps, solid opaque object interiors, NO exterior glow, bloom, haze, aura, diffuse cast shadow, scenery, frame or gradient background.
Avoid: whole boat, masts, sails, oars, cannons, engines, screw propeller, crew, text, badge, shields, busy rope or rivet patterns, miniature technical plan.
LOW tier warm copper BRONZE: ONE slightly curved rectangular PATCH of THREE thick overlapping clinker strakes, each lower edge visibly stepping out over the strake beneath like a staircase. THREE or FOUR large simple round rivet heads at the overlapping seam. One cropped timber backing frame visible at the side, no entire boat. Dominant silhouette a compact solid stepped plank shell, clinker lap joints CLEAR and large, no flat carvel seams.

entries.name_fr: Serres de cale et baux traversants

qa.visual_inspection: Originaux et comparaison 180/64/32 pixels inspectés. Bronze : trois strakes superposées avec rivets et fragment de soutien ; argent : trois varangues courbes ouvertes liées à un axe central ; or : cale ouverte et baux aux extrémités saillantes. Silhouettes distinctes en miniature ; détails des assemblages et longueurs de pièces symboliques plutôt que plans techniques exacts. Halo extérieur visible sur argent malgré la consigne ; alpha des originaux préservé sans retouche.

integration_note: Trois masters approuvés exacts conservés sans retouche, alpha et halo argent inclus. Trois DDS natifs 120 × 120 / sept mipmaps installés ; seuls les liens aor_cog_armor_low/mid/high changent. Statistiques, recettes, déblocages et flottes inchangés. Aucun essai en jeu.
